notes: RBox contraction paired with biology-replace-0018: it removes the revision's original property (A species belongs to at most one genus at a time), so every query expects 'does not know'; the propositional questions follow strong Kleene (not unknown, true and unknown, false or unknown are all unknown). The instances give their premises in the prompt and ask whether the conclusion follows; no stored sentence of the conclusion is expected in the corpus. Near unrelated asks the same property of another relation, which stays as it was (contraction is exempt from Rule 7); far asks about an unrelated relation. hops counts the prompt's premises as one bridge.
